O.outcome_detail: association between situational interest and user experience

cells.quote: "a significant and moderate positive correlation was observed between SI and students' UX (r (295) = .621, p < .001)"
cells.note: The exact correlation sentence is reported in the wiki entry rather than the supplied study-text excerpt.

cells.quote: "Additionally, there was a significant moderate association between students’ PLE and their UX (r (296) = .521, p < .001)"
cells.note: The reported finding appears in the wiki entry, but the supplied study text does not include the results sentence.

cells.quote: "In the nine studies reporting results on perceived usefulness of the proposed application [19,46,47,56,57,60,62,63,67], the vast majority of test subjects gave positive ratings to this specific aspect. Three studies (33%) [46,56,62] report differences between subject groups, with less experienced participants having overall more positive opinions towards the technology than more experienced ones."
